text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘Helping Mummy’ (मम्मी की मदद)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘Helping Mummy’ (Mummy ki madad). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘Helping Mummy’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘clean’ मतलब साफ़ करना। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘clean’ matlab saaf karna. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘clean’ means साफ़ करना. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘clothes’ मतलब कपड़े। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘clothes’ matlab kapde. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘clothes’ means कपड़े. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘proud’ मतलब गर्व। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘proud’ matlab garv. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘proud’ means गर्व. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: On Sunday I help Mummy at home.
I fold my clothes and keep them in the cupboard.
Then I water the plants on the balcony.
Mummy looks at my room and says, "Good job!"

question.hi: बच्चा मम्मी की मदद कब करता है?
question.hinglish: Bachcha Mummy ki madad kab karta hai?
question.en: When does the child help Mummy?

question.hi: बच्चा पौधों को क्या देता है?
question.hinglish: Bachcha paudhon ko kya deta hai?
question.en: What does the child give the plants?
